title: Loyalty wallet
summary: Fidélité / cagnotte. Wallet spend at checkout and earn on paid orders.
preferences: None. Wallet lives on the account page, not a Boutique toggle.
cart: priceAuthenticatedCheckout and priceGuestCheckout call priceLoyaltyIfEnabled. When the plugin is off the credit is always 0 and the wallet field is hidden. When it is on, loyaltyCredit is subtracted from the pre-loyalty total on the server. The client preview is not trusted.
orders: confirmAuthenticatedOrder writes loyalty_credit, loyalty_earn and loyalty_earn_status on the order row. GET /account/orders and admin order detail expose loyaltyCredit through the order presenter. History shows the cagnotte line from that snapshot even if the plugin is later disabled (the money already moved). New spends are refused while the plugin is off.
profile: Account, Fidélité. OpeningEntries on My profile can show a wallet card. Notification rows can remind before expiry.
notifications: Participate in core.notifications.entries for expiry reminders when the account opted in.

sections.heading: Call the service, do not import loyalty files
paragraphs: Other plugins must not import modules/loyalty/http or infrastructure. Call priceLoyaltyIfEnabled from orders/application (already the checkout path) or getPluginService("commerce-loyalty") if you register a public API. Disable the plugin and isPluginEffectivelyEnabled("commerce-loyalty") is false.
